description.en: The ID of the destination RDS instance.
The estimated data size, in GB.

description.zh: 源端MySQL Host IP，RDS会访问该IP并获取备份
description.en: The IP address of the source MySQL database. RDS accesses this IP address to obtain a backup.

description.zh: 源端MySQL账户密码，需要进行Base64编码
description.en: The password for the source MySQL user. It must be Base64-encoded.
The port of the source MySQL database.
The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~610399~~) operation to query the latest region list.
The ID of the cloud instance that hosts the source database.
The type of the cloud instance that hosts the source database.

description.zh: 流式传输端口，用于传输备份
description.en: The streaming port used to transfer the backup.
The installation path of xtrabackup on the source server.

descriptions.zh: 创建数据导入任务，用于RDS MySQL原生复制实例数据导入
descriptions.en: Creates a data import task to import data into an RDS for MySQL instance that uses native replication.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds create-import-task --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host 172.20.246.90 --port 3306 --stream-port 9999 --user myadmin --password OEF5JjVOM2pzZXFKRw== --source-platform ECS --source-instance-id i-bp1fe296n52ub3chezpg --xtrabackup-path /usr/bin/xtrabackup --db-instance-id rm-bp1u00000ggm7j9j --estimated-size 1000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds CreateImportTask --region cn-hangzhou --SourcePlatform ECS --User myadmin --XtrabackupPath '/usr/bin/xtrabackup' --EstimatedSize 1000 --Port 3306 --StreamPort 9999 --Host '172.20.246.90' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SourceInstanceId 'i-bp1fe296n52ub3chezpg' --DbInstanceId 'rm-bp1u00000ggm7j9j' --Password 'OEF5JjVOM2pzZXFKRw=='
